game: PIT @ CLE, Week 4 2026 (morning of kickoff; spread, total, kickoff time, rest, travel not in pack)

script.base: No spread or total is saved, so this is a form script, not a market script, and nobody can say who the book expects to lead. Pittsburgh's reliable path is Jaylen Warren (38 carries, 216 yards, 5.7 YPC) with Rico Dowdle out, into a Cleveland run defense allowing 4.73 YPC and 13 runs of 10+. Cleveland cannot lean on Quinshon Judkins (42 carries, 124 yards, 2.95 YPC) with C Elgton Jenkins and G Teven Jenkins both out, so Deshaun Watson's rushes (20 carries, 109 yards, about 36 a game) and the pass game have to create. Cleveland blitzes only 20%, which is Aaron Rodgers' better environment (PIT EPA/db -0.17 with no blitz vs -0.40 when blitzed), and Cleveland's only soft passing zone is the middle (9.44 YPA on 18 attempts), where Pat Freiermuth has lived (14 targets, 108 yards, 118 air).
script.flip1: Pittsburgh gets ahead and clocks it with Warren. Freiermuth and Roman Wilson lose late targets, and DK Metcalf's already-poor yardage (98 yards on 339 air) stalls further. Cleveland abandons Judkins; Watson scrambles or garbage throws go to Denzel Boston and K.C. Concepcion against a secondary missing Joey Porter Jr. with Jalen Ramsey questionable.
script.flip2: Shootout, or Cleveland stays in it with explosives. Pittsburgh bleeds outside (left 8.15 YPA on 34, right 8.0 on 28; 11 passes of 20+ for 89 yards), so Boston (195 yards, 225 air) and Harold Fannin Jr. (126 yards on 18 targets) cook, Judkins' carries never pile up, and both passing games have volume. Warren's rush line is the one that dies if Pittsburgh is throwing from behind.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Cleveland played a closed middle, Pittsburgh ran Warren 22 times with Dowdle out, and Freiermuth saw two targets and finished at 18, the same way a 30-yard floor was already one quiet game from a loss. On the other side the backup interior held up, Pittsburgh's 4.56 YPC defense and 9 explosive runs showed up, Watson's designed runs were cut, and Judkins got a 20-carry grind or one 25-yard run and finished at 64, the same shape as his 70-yard game. The missing sims would not have saved either if those scripts hit, and a late Ramsey active or a Jenkins surprise active would have moved the CLE pass and run pictures after this read.
slip_story: One story: the board is still pricing healthy roles. Cleveland's interior line is not healthy, so Judkins rush yards under 56.5. Cleveland's middle is the defensive hole, so Freiermuth receiving yards over 27.5. They do not need opposite scripts. A Pittsburgh lead helps the Judkins under and still leaves Freiermuth his 4-5 target role against a sub-30 line. A competitive pass game helps Freiermuth and keeps Judkins off a 20-carry grind. Do not add Metcalf, Boston, Warren, or a TD. Metcalf's air yards can bust an under in one play, Boston has no price, and Warren's 46/43 log disagrees with over 75.5. Two legs, no same-game total, one market per player.
